Get marketplace statistics

Source: R/marketplace.R
dig_price_stats.Rd

Gets the lowest price and the number of copies for sale of releases in the 'Discogs' marketplace. A token is not needed.

Usage

dig_price_stats(id, currency = NULL)

Arguments

id

One or more release IDs, as numbers or as codes copied from 'Discogs' such as "r249504" or "[r249504]".

currency

The currency of the prices, one of "USD", "GBP", "EUR", "CAD", "AUD", "JPY", "CHF", "MXN", "BRL", "NZD", "SEK" or "ZAR", or NULL for the default.

Value

A tibble with one row per release, or NULL invisibly if the API cannot be reached. The columns are release_id, lowest_price, currency, for_sale, the number of copies for sale, and blocked, which is TRUE if the release may not be sold. lowest_price and currency are NA if no copy is for sale, and for_sale is NA if the release is blocked.

Details

Prices change quickly, so these requests are never cached. Without a token and without currency, prices are in US dollars. With a token, they are in the buyer currency of your account.

Restricted Data

Collections, wantlists, usernames and marketplace data, such as prices and collection values, are Restricted Data under the 'Discogs' API Terms of Use. 'Discogs' grants each user a limited, personal licence to access and use them with their own token. They may not be passed on to anyone else or used for commercial purposes, and their use must respect the privacy of their owners. Keep them, and tallies and plots of them, for your own use, and do not publish them. The Terms of Use also forbid using the API to get around the 'Discogs' marketplace.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
dig_price_stats(249504, currency = "EUR")
}
